 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core'
AS $function$select mir_core.job_allowed(org,jid,auth.uid())$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mir_core.staff_role(org uuid, member uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core'
AS $function$
 select case when exists(select 1 from mir_core.memberships m where m.organization_id=org and m.user_id=member and m.active and m.role='admin') then 'admin'
 else (select p.staff_role from mir_core.staff_capabilities p join mir_core.memberships m
  on(m.organization_id,m.user_id)=(p.organization_id,p.user_id)
  where p.organization_id=org and p.user_id=member and p.active and m.active and m.role='employee') end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mir_core.conversation_allowed(org uuid, conversation uuid, member uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core'
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from mir_core.conversation_participants p join mir_core.memberships m
  on(m.organization_id,m.user_id)=(p.organization_id,p.user_id)
  where p.organization_id=org and p.conversation_id=conversation and p.user_id=member and p.active and m.active);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mir_conversation_private(org uuid, other uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core'
AS $function$declare me uuid:=auth.uid();mine text;theirs text;result uuid;begin
 mine:=mir_core.staff_role(org,me);theirs:=mir_core.staff_role(org,other);
 if me=other or mine is null or theirs is null or not(
  mine='boss' or(mine='assistant' and theirs in ('employe','chef_equipe')) or
  (mine='chef_equipe' and theirs='boss') or(mine='employe' and theirs in ('assistant','boss')) or
  (mine in ('chef_equipe','employe') and theirs in ('chef_equipe','employe') and exists(select 1 from mir_core.team_members a join mir_core.team_members b on(a.organization_id,a.team_id)=(b.organization_id,b.team_id) where a.organization_id=org and a.user_id=me and b.user_id=other and a.active and b.active))
 ) then raise exception 'Conversation non autorisée' using errcode='42501';end if;
 select c.id into result from mir_core.conversations c where c.organization_id=org and c.kind='private'
 and exists(select 1 from mir_core.conversation_participants p where p.organization_id=org and p.conversation_id=c.id and p.user_id=me and p.active)
 and exists(select 1 from mir_core.conversation_participants p where p.organization_id=org and p.conversation_id=c.id and p.user_id=other and p.active)
 and (select count(*) from mir_core.conversation_participants p where p.organization_id=org and p.conversation_id=c.id and p.active)=2 limit 1;
 if result is null then result:=gen_random_uuid();insert into mir_core.conversations values(org,result,'private',null,me,now());insert into mir_core.conversation_participants values(org,result,me,true,now()),(org,result,other,true,now());end if;return result;end$function$

declare role_name text:=mir_core.staff_role(org);begin
 if role_name is null and not mir_core.has_role(org,array['admin']) then raise exception 'Accès interne requis' using errcode='42501';end if;
 if job is not null and not mir_core.job_allowed(org,job) then raise exception 'Chantier non autorisé' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('role',case when role_name='admin' then 'boss' else coalesce(role_name,'boss') end,
  'teams',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'name',t.name,'leaderId',t.leader_id)) from mir_core.teams t where t.organization_id=org and t.active and (mir_core.has_role(org,array['admin']) or exists(select 1 from mir_core.team_members m where m.organization_id=org and m.team_id=t.id and m.user_id=auth.uid() and m.active))),'[]'),
  'conversations',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'kind',c.kind,'teamId',c.team_id,'unread',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.user_id=auth.uid() and r.read_at is null and exists(select 1 from mir_core.messages x where x.organization_id=org and x.id=r.message_id and x.conversation_id=c.id)))) from mir_core.conversations c where c.organization_id=org and mir_core.conversation_allowed(org,c.id)),'[]'),
  'messages',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',m.id,'conversationId',m.conversation_id,'senderId',m.sender_id,'body',m.body,'jobId',m.job_id,'planDocumentId',m.plan_document_id,'attachmentPath',m.attachment_path,'sentAt',m.sent_at,'deliveredCount',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.message_id=m.id and r.delivered_at is not null),'readCount',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.message_id=m.id and r.read_at is not null),'recipientCount',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.message_id=m.id)) order by m.sent_at desc) from mir_core.messages m where m.organization_id=org and mir_core.conversation_allowed(org,m.conversation_id)),'[]'),
  'hrRequests',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',h.id,'employeeId',h.employee_id,'type',h.request_type,'startDate',h.start_date,'endDate',h.end_date,'status',h.status,'createdAt',h.created_at) order by h.created_at desc) from mir_core.hr_requests h where h.organization_id=org and(h.employee_id=auth.uid() or mir_core.has_role(org,array['admin']))),'[]'),
  'extras',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)-'client_request_id') from mir_core.extras e where e.organization_id=org and(job is null or e.job_id=job) and mir_core.job_allowed(org,e.job_id)),'[]'),
  'receipts',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)-'client_request_id') from mir_core.delivery_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and(job is null or r.job_id=job) and mir_core.job_allowed(org,r.job_id)),'[]'),
  'issues',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)-'client_request_id') from mir_core.delivery_issues i where i.organization_id=org and(job is null or i.job_id=job) and(mir_core.job_allowed(org,i.job_id) or role_name='assistant')),'[]'),
  'activity',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.created_at desc) from mir_core.job_activity a where a.organization_id=org and(job is null or a.job_id=job) and mir_core.job_allowed(org,a.job_id)),'[]'),
  'notifications',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(n) order by n.created_at desc) from mir_core.notifications n where n.organization_id=org and n.user_id=auth.uid()),'[]'));
end

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mir_employee_operations_snapshot(org uuid, job uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core'
AS $function$declare role_name text:=mir_core.staff_role(org);begin
 if role_name is null and not mir_core.has_role(org,array['admin']) then raise exception 'Accès interne requis' using errcode='42501';end if;
 if job is not null and not mir_core.job_allowed(org,job) then raise exception 'Chantier non autorisé' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('role',case when role_name='admin' then 'boss' else coalesce(role_name,'boss') end,
  'teams',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'name',t.name,'leaderId',t.leader_id)) from mir_core.teams t where t.organization_id=org and t.active and (mir_core.has_role(org,array['admin']) or exists(select 1 from mir_core.team_members m where m.organization_id=org and m.team_id=t.id and m.user_id=auth.uid() and m.active))),'[]'),
  'conversations',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'kind',c.kind,'teamId',c.team_id,'unread',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.user_id=auth.uid() and r.read_at is null and exists(select 1 from mir_core.messages x where x.organization_id=org and x.id=r.message_id and x.conversation_id=c.id)))) from mir_core.conversations c where c.organization_id=org and mir_core.conversation_allowed(org,c.id)),'[]'),
  'messages',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',m.id,'conversationId',m.conversation_id,'senderId',m.sender_id,'body',m.body,'jobId',m.job_id,'planDocumentId',m.plan_document_id,'attachmentPath',m.attachment_path,'sentAt',m.sent_at,'deliveredCount',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.message_id=m.id and r.delivered_at is not null),'readCount',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.message_id=m.id and r.read_at is not null),'recipientCount',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.message_id=m.id)) order by m.sent_at desc) from mir_core.messages m where m.organization_id=org and mir_core.conversation_allowed(org,m.conversation_id)),'[]'),
  'hrRequests',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',h.id,'employeeId',h.employee_id,'type',h.request_type,'startDate',h.start_date,'endDate',h.end_date,'status',h.status,'createdAt',h.created_at) order by h.created_at desc) from mir_core.hr_requests h where h.organization_id=org and(h.employee_id=auth.uid() or mir_core.has_role(org,array['admin']))),'[]'),
  'extras',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)-'client_request_id') from mir_core.extras e where e.organization_id=org and(job is null or e.job_id=job) and mir_core.job_allowed(org,e.job_id)),'[]'),
  'receipts',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)-'client_request_id') from mir_core.delivery_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and(job is null or r.job_id=job) and mir_core.job_allowed(org,r.job_id)),'[]'),
  'issues',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)-'client_request_id') from mir_core.delivery_issues i where i.organization_id=org and(job is null or i.job_id=job) and(mir_core.job_allowed(org,i.job_id) or role_name='assistant')),'[]'),
  'activity',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.created_at desc) from mir_core.job_activity a where a.organization_id=org and(job is null or a.job_id=job) and mir_core.job_allowed(org,a.job_id)),'[]'),
  'notifications',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(n) order by n.created_at desc) from mir_core.notifications n where n.organization_id=org and n.user_id=auth.uid()),'[]'));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mir_messaging_snapshot(org uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core'
AS $function$declare role_name text:=mir_core.staff_role(org);begin
 if role_name is null and not mir_core.has_role(org,array['admin']) then raise exception 'Accès interne requis' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return jsonb_build_object(
  'contacts',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.user_id,'name',coalesce(nullif(p.display_name,''),p.user_id::text),'role',p.staff_role) order by p.display_name) from mir_core.staff_capabilities p where p.organization_id=org and p.active and p.user_id<>auth.uid()),'[]'),
  'teams',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'name',t.name,'leaderId',t.leader_id)) from mir_core.teams t where t.organization_id=org and t.active and (mir_core.has_role(org,array['admin']) or exists(select 1 from mir_core.team_members x where x.organization_id=org and x.team_id=t.id and x.user_id=auth.uid() and x.active))),'[]'),
  'conversations',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'kind',c.kind,'teamId',c.team_id,'participants',(select jsonb_agg(p.user_id) from mir_core.conversation_participants p where p.organization_id=org and p.conversation_id=c.id and p.active),'unread',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r join mir_core.messages m on(m.organization_id,m.id)=(r.organization_id,r.message_id) where r.organization_id=org and r.user_id=auth.uid() and r.read_at is null and m.conversation_id=c.id))) from mir_core.conversations c where c.organization_id=org and mir_core.conversation_allowed(org,c.id)),'[]'),
  'messages',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',m.id,'conversationId',m.conversation_id,'senderId',m.sender_id,'body',m.body,'jobId',m.job_id,'planDocumentId',m.plan_document_id,'attachmentPath',m.attachment_path,'sentAt',m.sent_at,'deliveredCount',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.message_id=m.id and r.delivered_at is not null),'readCount',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.message_id=m.id and r.read_at is not null),'recipientCount',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.message_id=m.id),'myReadAt',(select r.read_at from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.message_id=m.id and r.user_id=auth.uid())) order by m.sent_at) from mir_core.messages m where m.organization_id=org and mir_core.conversation_allowed(org,m.conversation_id)),'[]'));
end$function$

functions.prosrc: select mir_core.staff_role(org,member) in ('admin','boss') or exists(select 1 from mir_core.job_memberships j join mir_core.memberships m on(m.organization_id,m.user_id)=(j.organization_id,j.user_id) where j.organization_id=org and j.job_id=job and j.user_id=member and m.active and m.role='employee')

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mir_core.job_allowed(org uuid, job uuid, member uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core'
AS $function$select mir_core.staff_role(org,member) in ('admin','boss') or exists(select 1 from mir_core.job_memberships j join mir_core.memberships m on(m.organization_id,m.user_id)=(j.organization_id,j.user_id) where j.organization_id=org and j.job_id=job and j.user_id=member and m.active and m.role='employee')$function$

functions.prosrc:
select member is not null
 and exists(select 1 from mir_core.memberships m where m.organization_id=org and m.user_id=member and m.active)
 and (
   mir_core.has_role(org,array['admin'])
   or mir_core.staff_role(org,member) in ('boss','assistant')
   or mir_core.job_allowed(org,jid,member)
   or (mir_core.staff_role(org,member)='warehouse' and exists(
     select 1 from mir_core.delivery_run_orders dro
     join mir_core.delivery_runs dr on (dr.organization_id,dr.id)=(dro.organization_id,dro.run_id)
     where dro.organization_id=org and dro.job_id=jid
       and (dr.driver_id=member or mir_core.staff_role(org,member)='warehouse')
   ))
 );
